card.name: Words introducing a test's method
card.fires_on: The word right after 'based' (on, on the) in 'glucose tests based on ...', where the principle of a test method comes next. It also fires on 'gravity' in 'gravity flow' and on 'enzymatic' in assay descriptions.

modes.label: Tests based on a method
modes.description: 'on' or 'the' after 'tests based' in urine or blood glucose test interference warnings.
modes.example: It is recommended that glucose tests based<< on>> enzymatic glucose oxidase reactions be used

modes.label: Gravity flow
modes.description: The word 'gravity' naming a gravity-driven flow or operation method.
modes.example: The reconstituted TICE BCG is instilled into the bladder by<< gravity>> flow via the catheter.

modes.label: Enzymatic assay wording
modes.description: Partway through 'enzymatic' when describing how an assay works.
modes.example: All of the assays in which interference has been reported involve enzym<<atic>> coupling of the assay to oxidation

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'method' or '-style', such as 式 and METHOD.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name the method or principle behind a test or procedure.
